sessions.phase_label: Voice-over recording, revision, editing, and delivery

requirements.title: Separate Audio File Delivery
requirements.definition: Each requested voice-over track or take must be delivered as an individual audio file, with MP3 accepted as a sufficient format.
requirements.boundary_note: File separation and accepted format are attributes of one delivery-packaging mechanism; recording variants, performance direction, and audio editing remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Alternate Voice-Over Takes
requirements.definition: Produce multiple distinct voice-over versions so the client can compare and shortlist alternative delivery directions.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested number and selection of takes are attributes of the alternate-take deliverable; vocal style, sentence pacing, post-production editing, and file packaging can change independently.

requirements.title: Voice Tone and Energy
requirements.definition: The vocal performance must convey the requested energetic, lively, inspiring, and subtly proud tone without overacting.
requirements.boundary_note: Energy, liveliness, inspiration, pride, and restraint are coupled qualities of the overall performance style; the independently correctable pacing of the final sentence is excluded.

requirements.title: Final Sentence Pacing
requirements.definition: The final sentence must flow smoothly without excessive pauses while preserving the intended performance tone.
requirements.boundary_note: This localized pacing behavior received its own failure report and revision and can be corrected independently of the recording's broader tone and energy.

requirements.title: Editing of Shortlisted Takes
requirements.definition: Apply audio post-production editing to all four shortlisted voice-over takes before delivering them for approval.
requirements.boundary_note: Post-production of the shortlisted recordings is independently requested after raw takes were supplied; individual-file packaging and management approval are excluded.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
For delivery, please provide each track as a separate audio file; MP3 would be fine and sufficient.

Thank you for replying so quickly and for your interest in the project, Nadia. I look forward to receiving and hearing the tracks!

value_updates.file_separation: each track must be delivered as a separate audio file

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Across the shortlisted takes, I hear four distinct directions, and the 6th and 8th are especially good. Could you edit all four and send each one individually so I can forward them to senior managers for approval?

Thank you, Nadia. I’ll make the initial payment next Tuesday, but could we hold the remaining amount until Friday so the final take can receive final approval?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
After listening to the takes, I preferred **Take Seven**, especially because of the pauses. However, we would love to try four additional versions with even more energy and liveliness in the delivery.

The demo I’m sharing now is AI-generated and is intended only as a reference for our target tone and energy. Of course, your vibrant voice will bring it to life much better!

I also sincerely apologize for my delayed response. An emergency required me to take nine days off, and I truly appreciate your patience, effort, and the multiple takes you sent.

Although we have a time difference, please tell me when you can record next Monday. I’ll make sure I’m online and responsive at that time.

Best regards!

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I’ve now recorded seven takes and delivered them for review. They’re still raw and haven’t been edited, so please listen to all seven and tell me which one, if any, you prefer.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports recording and delivering seven raw takes for the client to compare.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Of the options, I liked the fourth one. However, the final sentence, “without you having to wait..”, seems to contain too many pauses.

Could we make that part flow more smoothly while sounding inspiring and conveying a little pride, but without overacting?

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Here are eight more takes with the smoother, inspiring, proud, energetic, and lively delivery you requested. The sixth one combines the fourth one you liked with a revised version of its final sentence.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports delivering eight additional takes, including a new variation based on the previously preferred fourth take.
